description: S4 (dual-message path): obstacle on road_1_4_3_1, the NTST through lane of intersection_1_3's North approach, 10 m upstream of the stop line. One event record, two controllers informed: intersection_1_3 gets the approach-full bullet (North/NTST/segment 1), intersection_1_4 gets the downstream bullet (South exit, 1 of 3 lanes, 563 m past on a 573 m link). 573 - 563 = 10 m before the stop line = segment 1: both messages describe the same spot.
